verdict.rationale: Navan documents policy and approval workflows (docs-25). Its MCP can explain why a transaction was flagged, who needs to approve it and which policy applies (docs-22), and can surface flagged, unapproved expenses (docs-5). That shows approval and policy-check state is tracked per expense, but nothing in the evidence describes an actual audit trail. Missing for 10: per-expense edit/change history log, immutable or tamper-evident audit records, approver timestamps/history, audit-ready export or retention guarantees, independent corroboration that records hold up in an external audit.
